findings.title: Arrow navigation after paging loses position
findings.message: After the user pages with Previous/Next, SelectedID is set from the browsed page, and move() clears browsing and recomputes from selected(rows). If SelectedID is empty (an all-unavailable page), selection resets to index 0 and Up/Down jumps to the wrong place. It also silently ignores the browsed window.
findings.suggestion: Keep the browsing state while moving, or derive the starting index from the browsed window instead of resetting to the first enabled item.

findings.title: Execution error message is set on an already closed palette
findings.message: close() calls Dismiss, then Invoke runs. A panic or reentrant mutation in Dismiss or Invoke can leave state inconsistent. The panel is already closed when the error is shown, so p.message is set on a closed palette and never displayed. The user receives no in-panel feedback, contrary to the docs claiming errors are reported via Message.
findings.suggestion: Document that errors surface only via OnError/Message after close, or keep the palette open on failure by reopening or invoking before closing.
